_install: Add devDependency eslint-plugin-promise (pnpm add -D eslint-plugin-promise), then merge rules+overrides into package.json eslintConfig and add "promise" to its plugins. Generalize override paths to this app's real logger and sink files. Make sure build output is ignored (eslintConfig "ignorePatterns": ["dist", "build"] or an .eslintignore) — otherwise `eslint .` lints the bundles and reports false catch-must-log/no-console hits after the first build. TypeScript apps: also add @typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises with ignoreVoid:false (requires type-checked parser config).

no-restricted-syntax.message: This catch block swallows the error silently. Do exactly one of: (1) call logger.error/logger.apiError(...) to record it, (2) re-throw it with `throw` so a boundary or an upstream catch handles it, or (3) call showErrorWithDetails(error, { functionName }) to record AND display it to the user. The only allowed silent path is an intentional AbortController cancel: `if (e.name === 'AbortError') return;`.
